pages.text: Open a rival city's City Manager and choose $(l)Raid this city$(). Your nearest eligible town sends half its foot soldiers (2–12).$(br2)Defeat the defenders, then hold the centre for $(l)60 seconds$() uncontested. Taking an ordinary city gives you that city; taking a $(l)capital$() gives you $(l)every city$() of that kingdom.

NPC kingdoms raid too, including you. A warning tells you which city is attacked and whether your capital is at stake.$(br2)Raids pause while armies are unloaded; no chunks are force-loaded. Surviving soldiers change sides on conquest; Royal Guard status is cleared.

While one of your cities attacks or is attacked, a bar at the top of the screen follows the raid: how long the centre has been held of the 60 seconds, and the time left before the attack fails. The city's $(l)Overview$() shows the same.
